name: proxispeak
description: ProxiSpeak — geospatial proximity audio ecosystem (single Web Service)

scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
